    <title>containerd 2.4.0</title>
    <content type="html"><p>Welcome to the v2.4.0 release of containerd!</p>
<p>containerd 2.4 is a regular (non-LTS) release with a shorter support window,<br>
intended for users who want to adopt new features sooner. As the release<br>
following the 2.3 LTS, it is the point in the release cycle where previously<br>
deprecated features may be removed, so this release may include breaking<br>
changes; check the notes below and clear any deprecation warnings from your<br>
current version before upgrading.</p>
<p>Users prioritizing stability and a longer support lifecycle should stay on the<br>
2.3 LTS release.</p>
<h3>Highlights</h3>
<h4>Container Runtime Interface (CRI)</h4>
<ul>
<li>Enable mount manager for image mounts in CRI (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13542" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13542/hovercard">#13542</a>)</li>
<li>Export sandbox image and CNI directory configuration in CRI plugin info (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13940" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13940/hovercard">#13940</a>)</li>
<li>Set default runtimeFeatures.UserNamespacesHostNetwork to true (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13162" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13162/hovercard">#13162</a>)</li>
<li>Support OCI runtime feature introspection for non-runc runtimes (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13504" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13504/hovercard">#13504</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Image Distribution</h4>
<ul>
<li>Apply hardening to strip sensitive authentication headers when fetching descriptor URLs (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/12889" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/12889/hovercard">#12889</a>)</li>
<li>Support propagating HTTP 299 warning headers from registries to the resolver (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/12698" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/12698/hovercard">#12698</a>)</li>
<li>Use klauspost/compress for gzip layer decompression (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13560" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13560/hovercard">#13560</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Image Storage</h4>
<ul>
<li>Add client options to fetch all layer content during unpack even when snapshots exist (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14126" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14126/hovercard">#14126</a>)</li>
<li>Include media type in content create events (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13833" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13833/hovercard">#13833</a>)</li>
<li>Add forward References to the GC collection context (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13634" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13634/hovercard">#13634</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Node Resource Interface (NRI)</h4>
<ul>
<li>Expose container image name, digest, and config digest to NRI plugins (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13960" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13960/hovercard">#13960</a>)</li>
<li>Emit deprecation warnings for plugins using deprecated NRI interfaces (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13916" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13916/hovercard">#13916</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Runtime</h4>
<ul>
<li>Mask /proc/interrupts and CPU thermal throttle sysfs paths in Linux containers by default (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14090" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14090/hovercard">#14090</a>)</li>
<li>Add UpdateSandbox RPC to propagate sandbox controller updates to the shim (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14105" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14105/hovercard">#14105</a>)</li>
<li>Avoid immediately restarting containers with restart=always policy after they are explicitly stopped (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13993" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13993/hovercard">#13993</a>)</li>
<li>Pass tracing context from shim to runc and hooks (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14036" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14036/hovercard">#14036</a>)</li>
<li>Fix user and group lookup failures in container rootfs containing symlinked /etc/passwd or /etc/group (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13818" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13818/hovercard">#13818</a>)</li>
<li>Implement Windows named-pipe server and log streaming support in pkg/shim (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13948" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13948/hovercard">#13948</a>)</li>
<li>Enable log scrubbing by default on Windows (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13837" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13837/hovercard">#13837</a>)</li>
<li>Allow specifying parent checkpoint directory when checkpointing with runc (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13699" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13699/hovercard">#13699</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Snapshotters</h4>
<ul>
<li>Add Prometheus metrics for EROFS snapshotter layer content cache (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13941" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13941/hovercard">#13941</a>)</li>
<li>Support warm image cache for erofs snapshotter (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13813" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13813/hovercard">#13813</a>)</li>
<li>Add max size label for snapshots (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13520" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13520/hovercard">#13520</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Breaking</h4>
<ul>
<li>Remove deprecated CRI and tracing configuration options:
<ul>
<li>Remove <code>enable_cdi</code> in CRI runtime configuration (CDI is now always enabled)</li>
<li>Remove <code>bin_dir</code> in CRI CNI configuration (use <code>bin_dirs</code>)</li>
<li>Remove <code>endpoint</code>, <code>protocol</code>, and <code>insecure</code> in OTLP tracing processor configuration (use standard OTLP environment variables)</li>
<li>Remove <code>service_name</code> and <code>sampling_ratio</code> in internal tracing configuration (use standard OpenTelemetry environment variables) (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14166" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14166/hovercard">#14166</a>)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Remove restore in CreateContainer (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13871" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13871/hovercard">#13871</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Deprecations</h4>
<ul>
<li>Deprecate containerd.io/runtime-allow-mounts shim annotation in favor of MountCapabilities bootstrap extension (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14002" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14002/hovercard">#14002</a>)</li>
<li>Remove deprecated shim.Command from pkg (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13991" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13991/hovercard">#13991</a>)</li>
<li>Deprecate task API address and version fields in runc options and move to CreateTaskRequest (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13360" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13360/hovercard">#13360</a>)</li>
</ul>
<p>Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at<br>
<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/issues">https://github.com/containerd/containerd/issues</a>.</p>

    <title>containerd API 1.12.0</title>
    <content type="html"><p>Welcome to the api/v1.12.0 release of containerd!</p>
<p>The 13th release for the containerd 1.x API aligns with the containerd 2.4 release.</p>
<h3>Highlights</h3>
<h4>Image Storage</h4>
<ul>
<li>Include media type in content create events (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13833" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13833/hovercard">#13833</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Runtime</h4>
<ul>
<li>Add UpdateSandbox RPC to propagate sandbox controller updates to the shim (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14105" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14105/hovercard">#14105</a>)</li>
<li>Allow specifying parent checkpoint directory when checkpointing with runc (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13699" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13699/hovercard">#13699</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Deprecations</h4>
<ul>
<li>Deprecate containerd.io/runtime-allow-mounts shim annotation in favor of MountCapabilities bootstrap extension (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14002" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14002/hovercard">#14002</a>)</li>
<li>Deprecate task API address and version fields in runc options and move to CreateTaskRequest (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13360" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13360/hovercard">#13360</a>)</li>
</ul>
<p>Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at<br>
<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/issues">https://github.com/containerd/containerd/issues</a>.</p>
<h3>Contributors</h3>

    <updated>2026-09-15T14:27:43Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/releases/tag/v2.4.0-rc.0"/>
    <title>containerd 2.4.0-rc.0</title>
    <content type="html"><p>Welcome to the v2.4.0-rc.0 release of containerd!<br>
<em>This is a pre-release of containerd</em></p>
<p>containerd 2.4 is a regular (non-LTS) release with a shorter support window,<br>
intended for users who want to adopt new features sooner. As the release<br>
following the 2.3 LTS, it is the point in the release cycle where previously<br>
deprecated features may be removed, so this release may include breaking<br>
changes; check the notes below and clear any deprecation warnings from your<br>
current version before upgrading.</p>
<p>Users prioritizing stability and a longer support lifecycle should stay on the<br>
2.3 LTS release.</p>
<h3>Highlights</h3>
<h4>Container Runtime Interface (CRI)</h4>
<ul>
<li>Enable mount manager for image mounts in CRI (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13542" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13542/hovercard">#13542</a>)</li>
<li>Export sandbox image and CNI directory configuration in CRI plugin info (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13940" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13940/hovercard">#13940</a>)</li>
<li>Set default runtimeFeatures.UserNamespacesHostNetwork to true (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13162" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13162/hovercard">#13162</a>)</li>
<li>Support OCI runtime feature introspection for non-runc runtimes (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13504" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13504/hovercard">#13504</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Image Distribution</h4>
<ul>
<li>Apply hardening to strip sensitive authentication headers when fetching descriptor URLs (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/12889" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/12889/hovercard">#12889</a>)</li>
<li>Support propagating HTTP 299 warning headers from registries to the resolver (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/12698" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/12698/hovercard">#12698</a>)</li>
<li>Use klauspost/compress for gzip layer decompression (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13560" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13560/hovercard">#13560</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Image Storage</h4>
<ul>
<li>Add client options to fetch all layer content during unpack even when snapshots exist (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14126" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14126/hovercard">#14126</a>)</li>
<li>Include media type in content create events (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13833" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13833/hovercard">#13833</a>)</li>
<li>Add forward References to the GC collection context (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13634" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13634/hovercard">#13634</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Node Resource Interface (NRI)</h4>
<ul>
<li>Expose container image name, digest, and config digest to NRI plugins (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13960" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13960/hovercard">#13960</a>)</li>
<li>Emit deprecation warnings for plugins using deprecated NRI interfaces (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13916" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13916/hovercard">#13916</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Runtime</h4>
<ul>
<li>Mask /proc/interrupts and CPU thermal throttle sysfs paths in Linux containers by default (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14090" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14090/hovercard">#14090</a>)</li>
<li>Add UpdateSandbox RPC to propagate sandbox controller updates to the shim (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14105" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14105/hovercard">#14105</a>)</li>
<li>Avoid immediately restarting containers with restart=always policy after they are explicitly stopped (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13993" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13993/hovercard">#13993</a>)</li>
<li>Pass tracing context from shim to runc and hooks (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14036" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14036/hovercard">#14036</a>)</li>
<li>Fix user and group lookup failures in container rootfs containing symlinked /etc/passwd or /etc/group (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13818" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13818/hovercard">#13818</a>)</li>
<li>Implement Windows named-pipe server and log streaming support in pkg/shim (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13948" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13948/hovercard">#13948</a>)</li>
<li>Enable log scrubbing by default on Windows (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13837" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13837/hovercard">#13837</a>)</li>
<li>Allow specifying parent checkpoint directory when checkpointing with runc (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13699" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13699/hovercard">#13699</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Snapshotters</h4>
<ul>
<li>Add Prometheus metrics for EROFS snapshotter layer content cache (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13941" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13941/hovercard">#13941</a>)</li>
<li>Support warm image cache for erofs snapshotter (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13813" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13813/hovercard">#13813</a>)</li>
<li>Add max size label for snapshots (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13520" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13520/hovercard">#13520</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Breaking</h4>
<ul>
<li>Remove restore in CreateContainer (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13871" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13871/hovercard">#13871</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Deprecations</h4>
<ul>
<li>Deprecate containerd.io/runtime-allow-mounts shim annotation in favor of MountCapabilities bootstrap extension (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14002" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14002/hovercard">#14002</a>)</li>
<li>Remove deprecated shim.Command from pkg (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13991" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13991/hovercard">#13991</a>)</li>
<li>Deprecate task API address and version fields in runc options and move to CreateTaskRequest (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13360" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13360/hovercard">#13360</a>)</li>
</ul>
<p>Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at<br>
<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/issues">https://github.com/containerd/containerd/issues</a>.</p>

    <title>containerd API 1.12.0-rc.1</title>
    <content type="html"><p>Welcome to the api/v1.12.0-rc.1 release of containerd!<br>
<em>This is a pre-release of containerd</em></p>
<p>The 13th release for the containerd 1.x API aligns with the containerd 2.4 release.</p>
<h3>Highlights</h3>
<h4>Image Storage</h4>
<ul>
<li>Include media type in content create events (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13833" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13833/hovercard">#13833</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Runtime</h4>
<ul>
<li>Add UpdateSandbox RPC to propagate sandbox controller updates to the shim (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14105" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14105/hovercard">#14105</a>)</li>
<li>Allow specifying parent checkpoint directory when checkpointing with runc (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13699" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13699/hovercard">#13699</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Deprecations</h4>
<ul>
<li>Deprecate containerd.io/runtime-allow-mounts shim annotation in favor of MountCapabilities bootstrap extension (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14002" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14002/hovercard">#14002</a>)</li>
<li>Deprecate task API address and version fields in runc options and move to CreateTaskRequest (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13360" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13360/hovercard">#13360</a>)</li>
</ul>
<p>Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at<br>
<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/issues">https://github.com/containerd/containerd/issues</a>.</p>
<h3>Contributors</h3>
<ul>
<li>Derek McGowan</li>

<li>Wei Fu</li>

    <title>containerd 2.3.5</title>
    <content type="html"><p>Welcome to the v2.3.5 release of containerd!</p>
<p>The fifth patch release for containerd 2.3 contains various fixes<br>
and updates including security patches.</p>
<h3>Security Updates</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>containerd</strong>
<ul>

<li>Fix configuration loading error when drop-in configuration files have a higher version than the root configuration (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13995" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13995/hovercard">#13995</a>)</li>
<li>Avoid containerd startup hangs when loading shims (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13983" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13983/hovercard">#13983</a>)</li>

<li>Fix Windows Server 2022 container compatibility on host builds newer than the latest LTSC (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/platforms/pull/34" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/platforms/pull/34/hovercard">containerd/platforms#34</a>)</li>

    <title>containerd 2.2.8</title>
    <content type="html"><p>Welcome to the v2.2.8 release of containerd!</p>
<p>The eighth patch release for containerd 2.2 contains various fixes<br>
and updates including security patches.</p>
<h3>Security Updates</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>containerd</strong>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-7jxh-36q5-gcqv"><strong>CVE-2026-53495</strong></a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-rp3h-jf77-q9p4"><strong>GHSA-rp3h-jf77-q9p4</strong></a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>Highlights</h3>
<h4>Image Distribution</h4>
<ul>
<li>Apply hardening to strip sensitive authentication headers when fetching descriptor URLs (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14044" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14044/hovercard">#14044</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Runtime</h4>
<ul>
<li>Set SystemTemp environment variable on Windows so temp directory overrides work for SYSTEM services (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14102" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14102/hovercard">#14102</a>)</li>
<li>Fix user and group lookup failures in container rootfs containing symlinked /etc/passwd or /etc/group (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/14005" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/14005/hovercard">#14005</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Snapshotters</h4>
<ul>
<li>Fix EROFS snapshot creation failure caused by concurrent snapshot removal (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13950" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13950/hovercard">#13950</a>)</li>
</ul>
<p>Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at<br>
<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/issues">https://github.com/containerd/containerd/issues</a>.</p>

<li><strong>containerd</strong>

    <content type="html"><p>Welcome to the v1.7.35 release of containerd!</p>
<p>The thirty-fifth patch release for containerd 1.7 contains various fixes<br>
and updates including security patches.</p>
<h3>Security Updates</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>containerd</strong>
<ul>

</ul>

<h3>Highlights</h3>
<h4>Image Distribution</h4>

    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/releases/tag/v2.3.4"/>
    <title>containerd 2.3.4</title>
    <content type="html"><p>Welcome to the v2.3.4 release of containerd!</p>
<p>The fourth patch release for containerd 2.3 contains various fixes and updates.</p>
<h3>Highlights</h3>
<h4>Container Runtime Interface (CRI)</h4>
<ul>
<li>Disable checkpoint restore in CreateContainer by default, requiring the enable_experimental_restore_via_create configuration option to enable (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13913" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13913/hovercard">#13913</a>)</li>
<li>Set default runtimeFeatures.UserNamespacesHostNetwork to true in CRI (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13914" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13914/hovercard">#13914</a>)</li>
<li>Deprecate checkpoint restore in CreateContainer (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13868" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13868/hovercard">#13868</a>)</li>
<li>Support non-UTF-8 binary environment variable values in CRI (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13454" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13454/hovercard">#13454</a>)</li>
<li>Enable OCI runtime feature introspection for non-runc runtimes in CRI (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13778" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13778/hovercard">#13778</a>)</li>
<li>Disable checkpoint restore codepaths when CRIU is not installed and add enable_criu configuration option (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13734" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13734/hovercard">#13734</a>)</li>
<li>Normalize sandbox image references in CRI to resolve images without domain prefixes (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13759" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13759/hovercard">#13759</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Node Resource Interface (NRI)</h4>
<ul>
<li>Emit deprecation warnings for plugins using deprecated NRI interfaces (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13935" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13935/hovercard">#13935</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Runtime</h4>
<ul>
<li>Enable log scrubbing by default on Windows (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13904" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13904/hovercard">#13904</a>)</li>
<li>Fix memory leak in OOM watcher map when stopping container monitoring (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13870" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13870/hovercard">#13870</a>)</li>
<li>Avoid orphaning shims on transient errors when loading process IDs (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13857" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13857/hovercard">#13857</a>)</li>
<li>Fix corruption of binary protobuf shim start responses caused by premature whitespace trimming (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13803" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13803/hovercard">#13803</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Snapshotters</h4>
<ul>
<li>Fix EROFS snapshotter dropping lower layers stacked above merged filesystem metadata (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13876" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13876/hovercard">#13876</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Breaking</h4>
<ul>
<li>Disable checkpoint restore in CreateContainer by default, requiring the enable_experimental_restore_via_create configuration option to enable (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13913" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13913/hovercard">#13913</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h4>Deprecations</h4>
<ul>
<li>Deprecate checkpoint restore in CreateContainer (<a href="https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/13868" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/containerd/containerd/pull/13868/hovercard">#13868</a>)</li>
</ul>
<p>Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at<br>
